name: Final Fight MD
storyline: Set in the fictional Metro City, the player controls one of three characters—former pro wrestler and newly elected mayor Mike Haggar, his daughter's boyfriend Cody, and Cody's best friend Guy—as they set out to defeat the Mad Gear gang and rescue Haggar's young daughter Jessica.
summary:
This is a homebrew version of the Final Fight arcade game for the SEGA Mega Drive, created from scratch without using any source code from the original.

As this is a work-in-progress project, please note that it contains numerous bugs, including graphics corruption, lockups, and other unusual behaviors that can occur during gameplay.
